# Praxis companion package - start here (final, manuscript v6.4)

**Manuscript:** Roberts_Praxis_Chapters_1_5_v6_4.docx (older versions: superseded/manuscripts/).
**Manuscript provenance:** v5.0–v5.7 were generated by code/build_praxis_v5*.js; v5.8 was revised by the author in Word (new Chapter 2, Appendix B); v5.9 applies code/edit_manuscript_v58_to_v59.py (AI disclosure, abstract, Chapter 2 citations, seven references). v6 applies code/edit_manuscript_v59_to_v6.py (table values reconciled to the frozen sources, reference links, acronym notes, table and figure cross-references, hypothesis restatements, Section 5.3 item 3). v6.1 applies code/edit_manuscript_v6_to_v6_1.py (seed-level assumption check in Section 4.7.3; values from code/42_seed_level_assumption_checks.py, saved in final_reproduction/seed_level_assumption_checks_v6_1.csv). v6.2 applies code/edit_manuscript_v6_1_to_v6_2.py (Section 1.3 problem statement and explanatory paragraph with two journal references; abstract and Section 1.1 framed around reliable assessment of combined evidence; no result changes). v6.3 applies code/edit_manuscript_v6_2_to_v6_3.py (one-sentence thesis statement in Section 1.4; former RQ3 split into RQ3–RQ5 matching H3′, H4 and H5 in Sections 1.6, 1.7 and 5.1; no result changes). v6.4 applies code/edit_manuscript_v6_3_to_v6_4.py (author’s thesis statement in Section 1.4; no result changes).
**Every reported number:** NUMBERS_FINAL.json (single source for slides and the defense).
**What reproduces what:** review_corrections_v31/COMPANION_PACKAGE_MAP.md.
**Clean-directory tests and their scope:** final_reproduction/CLEAN_DIR_TEST_FINAL.txt.
**Integrity:** `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS_package.txt` (the manifest excludes itself).

## 0. Install dependencies
    python -m pip install -r requirements-analysis.txt      # analysis scripts (includes tabulate for Markdown tables)
    python -m pip install -r requirements-models.txt        # only for notebook reruns (torch 2.8.0 CPU, IPython)

## Reproduce the reported tables without PyTorch (minutes)
    python code/41_reproduce_final_neural_tables_v33.py --predictions final_reproduction/final_neural_test_predictions_v33.csv --reference-inference rgcn_ablation/v33_final/seed_level_inference_v33.csv
    python code/40_review_corrections_v31.py --grid-dir review_corrections_v31 --repeats 500

## Re-run the models (PyTorch machine, PowerShell)
Define once per terminal: $PX = "C:\Praxis"; $PKG = "$PX\Praxis_NF3_Leakage_Safe_Reanalysis_v2"; $DEL = "$PX\Praxis_Tier1_Attack_Aware_Alignment_v3"; $ROOT = "$PX\torch_staging_root"; $CELLS = "$PX\coupling_cells"
1. Copy every file in code\ into $PKG\code\; copy rgcn_ablation\06_rgcn_leakage_safe_v3_trained.ipynb (v3.3) and rgcn_ablation\09_xai_validation_leakage_safe_v33.ipynb into $PKG\notebooks\.
2. Regime target (Step 1): python "$PKG\code\32_stage_torch_reruns_v3.py" ... --copy, then notebooks 05 and 06 for seeds 42-46 (commands in STEPS_1_2_REPORT and the v5 guide history).
3. Intensity cells: materialize with code\35_materialize_coupling_cell_v3.py (v3.1 seeding), Transformer via notebook 05, trained R-GCN and XAI via
       & "$DEL\rgcn_ablation\run_rgcn_v33_normalization_rerun.ps1"      <- FINAL entry point (checks notebook versions before running)
4. Regenerate the per-event prediction export (all paths are arguments; nothing is hard-coded):
       python "$PKG\\code\\export_final_neural_predictions_v33.py" --cells-root "$CELLS" --step1-root "$ROOT\\data\\processed\\point_event_v2" --position-bank "$DEL\\step2_coupling_study\\position_bank_cross_regime_v3.csv" --alignment-dir "$DEL\\alignment_v3_cross_regime" --output "$PX\\final_neural_test_predictions_v33.csv"
5. Checkpoints for archiving: & "$DEL\rgcn_ablation\collect_final_checkpoints_v3.ps1"
